subtasks.objective: Add authorization checks to the URY Order table_transfer and captain_transfer whitelisted methods so callers cannot move another bill between tables or captains unless they have POS Invoice write access and an approved transfer role.
subtasks.acceptance: table_transfer and captain_transfer verify write permission on the target POS Invoice before mutating it, enforce a documented caller role such as URY Cashier or URY Manager before changing table/waiter fields, preserve the existing same-branch, occupancy, merged-table, and same-room validations, and include focused tests or a documented bench-level verification that unauthorized waiters are rejected while authorized users can transfer.
